question: Is it safe to delete the wait?

claims.text: I added the wait as a hack. The vendor rejected requests that came too close together, and their support told me there was no burst allowance.

citations.quote: The vendor returns 429 if two requests from the same account land within 3 seconds, and their support confirmed there is no burst allowance.

claims.text: Without the delay the nightly batch lost about 8% of quotes. I noted then that the proper fix was a queue.

citations.quote: Without the delay the nightly batch loses about 8% of quotes. Proper fix is a queue.

claims.text: A later refactor kept the delay, renamed to PAUSE_MS. It left a TODO to remove it after migrating to a new tax vendor.

citations.quote: // TODO: remove this delay after migrating to the new tax vendor

claims.text: So no, not as things stand. The wait is there because of the old vendor's 3-second rule. It's only safe to delete once the migration to the new vendor is done, or once a queue replaces it. I can't tell from the ledger whether the migration has happened or whether the new vendor has the same limit.

citations.quote: // TODO: remove this delay after migrating to the new tax vendor
